description: This Java class implements data access object (DAO) functionality for TaxRate entities, providing methods to retrieve tax rates based on store, country, zone, code, and other criteria using QueryDSL and JPA.

classes.name: TaxRateDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of data access methods for TaxRate entities, extending base DAO and implementing custom queries for retrieving tax rates based on store, code, country, zone, etc.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of TaxRate objects associated with a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of TaxRate objects associated with a specific MerchantStore and Language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxRate object matching a given code within a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxRate object by its ID.

methods.name: listByCountryZoneAndTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves tax rates applicable to a specific country, zone, and tax class within a store, considering optional zone nullity.

methods.name: listByCountryStateProvinceAndTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves tax rates applicable to a specific country, state/province, and tax class within a store.
